name: Cetaphil

lead: Cetaphil is a skincare brand from Galderma, best known for its Gentle Skin Cleanser, a mild, low-foam wash, and for its moisturizing lotions and creams. It is sold in supermarkets and pharmacies in many countries.

In looksmaxxing, it is used as a basic cleanser and moisturizer, often next to treatments such as tretinoin that can dry or irritate skin. Keeping the skin barrier comfortable is the route to a calmer, smoother-looking complexion.

paras: People use the cleanser morning and evening and a moisturizer after, with retinoids or acne treatments applied separately. It is often chosen for sensitive or acne-prone skin because it is gentle and widely available. Skin comfort typically changes within days; visible texture changes come mostly from the active treatments used alongside it.

Reactions are uncommon but contact allergy to moisturizer ingredients has been reported. Older formulations contained parabens, propylene glycol and sodium lauryl sulfate; a 2021 reformulation added niacinamide, panthenol and glycerin. People with eczema or rosacea often discuss products with a dermatologist.

chain: Skin barrier stays comfortable and hydrated
Calmer skin that tolerates active treatments
angle.text: It serves as the basic wash and moisturizer in many routines, where the visible changes come from supporting skin health and tolerating actives.

lead: Cetaphil is a skincare brand owned by Galderma, a Swiss company, developed in Texas in 1947 and now sold in grocery stores and pharmacies in the United States, Canada and India, and in pharmacies in about 100 other countries [1]. Its range covers cleansers, bar soap, creams, lotions and moisturizers [1].

For appearance, its role is supportive: a mild cleanser and moisturizer help keep skin comfortable and hydrated, which matters for people using retinoids or acne treatments that can irritate. A split-face study found that a moisturizer improved tolerability of topical tretinoin [2].

Clinical papers include a study of the Gentle Skin Cleanser on the skin barrier of people with rosacea [3] and a trial of Cetaphil moisturizing cream in a daily regimen for individuals with rosacea [4]. A systematic review summarised randomized trials of Cetaphil moisturizers in atopic dermatitis [5].
infobox: Water, cetyl alcohol, propylene glycol, sodium lauryl sulfate, stearyl alcohol, parabens [1]
Over the counter, pharmacies and grocery stores [1]

paras: The Gentle Skin Cleanser is the flagship. A pre-2021 formula listed water, cetyl alcohol, propylene glycol, sodium lauryl sulfate, stearyl alcohol and three parabens; the 2021 reformulation added niacinamide, panthenol and glycerin [1].

Cetaphil is typically used as the gentle base of a routine alongside retinoids, acne treatments or sun protection. A randomized split-face study examined adjunctive use of a ceramide-containing SPF 30 facial moisturizer with tretinoin 0.05 percent and reported on tolerability [2]. A randomized trial of a peptide formulated in Cetaphil Moisturizing Facial Lotion used the lotion as its vehicle for assessing facial oiliness [6].

Studies include a 2006 trial on skin barrier effects of the Gentle Skin Cleanser in people with rosacea [3], a randomized trial of the moisturizing cream with rosacea regimens in 20 individuals [4], and a review of randomized trials in atopic dermatitis [5]. A study comparing the irritation of five common topical products is also in the literature [7].
A 2020 report describes allergic contact dermatitis from moisturizers, a reminder that reactions to cosmetic ingredients occur [8].

timeline.event: Cleanser reformulated to add niacinamide, panthenol and glycerin [1].
